children: We are pleased to invite you to our Annual Investor Day on
Mikkel Bryggers Gade 4, 2 floor 1460 Copenhagen C

This is an opportunity to meet board members and the management team and get your questions addressed. The main focus of this investor day is to provide an in-depth review of our project development pipeline. The event will also include a review of the half-year report and a strategy update
- Welcome by Jan Lehrmann, Chairman of the Board
- Half-Year Report Presentation by CFO Aran Taghizadeh
- Q&A Session on the Half-Year Report
- Marketing Update by CMO Frederik Vig
- Project Development Pipeline Overview by CEO Søren Gleie
Mikkel Bryggers Gade 4, 2. sal, 1460 Copenhagen K, Denmark

Trophy Games develops and operates games built around real-world interests. The Company applies a repeatable development approach across its portfolio, supported by a shared technology platform and codebase. Its portfolio includes titles such as Airline Manager, Truck Manager and Farm Manager.
Trophy Games is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and was founded in 2006.

title: Trophy Games Investor Day (September 8th 16.00)
